description: Minimum unit describing one BrodyMemoryDoc node's canonical tree tagging state. Produced by REGISTRY_34_TREE_DIRECT path using arbres_34.canon.json + title regex _Tnn__.

memory_id.description: BrodyMemoryDoc internal ID or title hash

source_path.description: BrodyMemoryDoc.source value (may be empty for 2363/3267 nodes)

text_preview_hash.description: sha256 of text_preview (for integrity check, not stored in Neo4j)

meaning_unit.description: Short semantic label extracted from title slug (after Tnn__)

canonical_tree_id.description: Tree ID from arbres_34.canon.json. Null if no _Tnn__ in title.
canonical_tree_id.derivation: regex _T(\d+)__ on title, zero-padded to 2 digits, prefixed T

folder_slug.description: Canonical folder slug from arbres_34.canon.json (for cross-reference)

kernel_metric_refs.description: IR alphabet tokens relevant to this doc (from SRC_003). Always advisory, never decision.

alphabet_refs.description: IR alphabet tokens from Reverse OS canon that match doc content domain

os_trad_refs.description: OS Trad module context if applicable

reverse_language_refs.description: Reverse OS concept IDs if applicable

confidence_source_based.description: 0.0-1.0 confidence from source evidence only. 0.99 for direct title match, 0.0 for no signal.

tagging_basis.description: How the tag was derived. Must NOT be HEURISTIC or LLM_GUESS.

allowed_scope.example: READONLY_DESIGN_ONLY — requires gate before Neo4j write

requires_operator_review.description: True for all writes — tag enrichment requires gate

new_tags_proposed.description: Tags to be added if gate is approved

existing_tags_preserved.description: Existing tags must be preserved — no removal

tagging_rules.rule_1: tag_source MUST be arbres_34.canon.json — no other source
tagging_rules.rule_2: tree_id extraction MUST use regex _T(\d+)__ on title only
tagging_rules.rule_3: family assignment MUST come from arbres_34.canon.json lookup by id
tagging_rules.rule_7: existing tags MUST be preserved — append only
tagging_rules.rule_8: docs without _Tnn__ in title MUST be marked PENDING_ADDITIONAL_SIGNAL
tagging_rules.rule_9: all writes require KX108 gate + writable memory protocol activation
tagging_rules.rule_10: boundary_all_false MUST remain true until gate is opened
